sources.title: 3DModelPainting — Online 3D Texture Painter
sources.snippet: 3DModelPainting is a browser-based texture editor for painting and editing the surface of any 3D model. Instead of wrestling with offline texture painting software, complex UV maps and heavy installs, you open your model in the browser and start painting directly on its geometry, exactly where you want color, detail and wear to land.

sources.title: SkinKit — Browser-Based USD Skin Weight Painting
sources.snippet: Free browser-based skeleton rigging and skin weight painting tool for USD files. Paint weights, run solvers, preview deformations — no installs required. Part of the StudioKit / 3DKit suite.
